name: Jennavieve Caeda
source:
Jennavieve Caeda is the sole child of the Caeda family. She runs Café de Luna, a popular hub in Kosmos due to its theme of subverting expectations.

While Jen has a cold demeanor at the start, she does have an interest in learning more about people, perhaps even opening up to them if the circumstances permit.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thetaugames/kosmos-connections-0]Kickstarter[/url]]

Jennavieve Caeda is the sole child of the Caeda family. She runs Café de Luna, a popular hub in Kosmos due to its theme of subverting expectations.

While Jen has a cold demeanor at the start, she does have an interest in learning more about people, perhaps even opening up to them if the circumstances permit.
